This guide navigates truck access for relocations into Ovid Gelan Gurra's rising smart zone.

Smart zone access layers

  • Primary vehicle gate with plate pre-registration.
  • Secondary pedestrian granite zones—no truck entry without escort.
  • Basement loading bays in tower phases—timed slots.
  • Construction coexistence lanes—flagmen override GPS.
  • Evening pedestrian priority—unload windows morning bias.

Permit package

Company registration; COI naming developer; crew ID list; truck dimensions; move window; tenant unit deed or lease copy; deposit receipt if compound requires.

Extra planning notes

Name your sub-city, compound, and floor at survey so gate lists and lift bookings match the truck that arrives. Keep passports, leases, and small electronics off the truck until the final walk-through. If management requires deposits for lifts or gates, pay only after you have a confirmed move window in writing.

Weather and holidays can shift traffic—buffer half a day on long cross-town legs. For inter-city or storage legs, confirm whether overnight hold or next-day unload is included in your quote line items.
